adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and a client action (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6#saveChanges` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`), but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` ignores params and simply re-renders the `@embedding` OpenStruct populated in `fetch_embedding` (id + `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)`). Also, `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` contains no UI element that triggers `saveChanges`, so the PUT path is unused in this diff. This is a real, diff-grounded maintenance/API-design concern (a misleading no-op endpoint) but it doesn't break the host/category editing flow, which persists via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`.
